Calendar Event Generator

Build a valid RFC 5545 .ics calendar file with title, dates, location, description and reminder — imports into Google, Apple and Outlook calendars.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the event title, start and end date/time, location and description.
  2. Optionally pick a reminder — a VALARM is embedded in the file.
  3. Click Download .ics, then open the file to add it to your calendar.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will the .ics file work in Google Calendar?

Yes. The file follows the RFC 5545 iCalendar standard, which Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook and most other apps can import.

Can I make an all-day event?

Check the All-day event box and only the date part is used; times are ignored.

Does it support reminders?

Yes, choose a reminder from the dropdown — a VALARM with a DISPLAY action is embedded in the event.

What timezone is the event stored in?

Dates you pick are converted to UTC timestamps (Z suffix), which every calendar app interprets in the viewer's own timezone.
